title: Part 4 — Talk 1: airport announcement
instructionsVi: Thông báo một chiều, mọi thông tin chỉ nói một lần. Có một chỗ đính chính thông tin in trên bảng.
promptEn: Listen to the announcement and answer questions 71 through 73.

transcript.speaker: Announcer
transcript.text: This is an announcement for passengers on flight LK four-one-two to Copenhagen.

transcript.speaker: Announcer
transcript.text: Boarding will now take place at gate twenty-two, not gate fifteen as shown on the departure boards. We apologise for the change.

transcript.speaker: Announcer
transcript.text: Boarding begins in twenty minutes and will be by row number. Passengers requiring assistance, and those travelling with young children, are invited to board first.

transcript.speaker: Announcer
transcript.text: Please have your boarding pass and passport ready. Note that only one item of hand luggage may be taken on board; any second bag will be placed in the hold free of charge at the gate.

transcript.speaker: Announcer
transcript.text: The flight is expected to arrive on schedule despite the gate change.

questions.prompt: 71. Which gate should passengers go to?
questions.explanationVi: 'gate twenty-two, not gate fifteen as shown on the departure boards'. Cổng 15 là thông tin SAI trên bảng.

options.text: Passengers needing assistance and those with young children

questions.explanationVi: 'Passengers requiring assistance, and those travelling with young children, are invited to board first'.

questions.prompt: 73. What happens to a second piece of hand luggage?

options.text: It goes in the hold at no cost.
It must be checked in earlier.

questions.explanationVi: 'any second bag will be placed in the hold free of charge at the gate'.

title: Part 4 — Talk 2: voicemail from a landlord
instructionsVi: Tin nhắn thoại. Có một yêu cầu hành động ở cuối và một điều kiện đi kèm.
promptEn: Listen to the telephone message and answer questions 74 through 76.

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Hello, this is Marek from Hartley Lettings, calling for Ms Nguyen about the flat on Meadow Road.

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: The boiler engineer can come on Thursday morning or Saturday afternoon. Thursday is a standard visit; Saturday carries a weekend call-out charge, though in this case we'd cover it since the fault is ours.

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: He'll need access to the airing cupboard, so if you're out, please leave a key with the neighbour and let me know which flat.

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: One more thing — the annual gas safety check is due next month, and we can combine the two visits if you take the Thursday slot. That saves you a second appointment.

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Call me back on 0117 496 2280 to confirm. If I don't hear by Wednesday lunchtime I'll book Thursday by default.

questions.prompt: 74. What is said about the Saturday appointment?

options.text: The tenant must pay a call-out charge.
It would include the gas safety check.
The charge would be covered by the agency.

questions.explanationVi: 'Saturday carries a weekend call-out charge, though in this case we'd cover it since the fault is ours'.

questions.prompt: 75. What is the advantage of the Thursday slot?

options.text: It is earlier in the week.
It is cheaper for the tenant.

questions.explanationVi: 'we can combine the two visits if you take the Thursday slot. That saves you a second appointment'.

questions.prompt: 76. What happens if the tenant does not reply?

options.text: Thursday will be booked by default.

questions.explanationVi: 'If I don't hear by Wednesday lunchtime I'll book Thursday by default'.

title: Part 4 — Talk 3: weather and travel bulletin
instructionsVi: Bản tin. Nhiều địa danh và mốc thời gian nối nhau nhanh — ghi nhanh trong lúc nghe.
promptEn: Listen to the bulletin and answer questions 77 through 79.

transcript.speaker: Presenter
transcript.text: Here is the travel and weather bulletin at seven forty-five.

transcript.speaker: Presenter
transcript.text: Heavy rain is expected across the region from mid-morning, easing by early evening. Localised flooding is likely on low-lying roads, particularly the coastal route between Fairport and Kirby.

transcript.speaker: Presenter
transcript.text: Rail services are running normally, but the operator has warned that speed restrictions may be introduced this afternoon if conditions worsen.

transcript.speaker: Presenter
transcript.text: The Harbour Bridge is closed to high-sided vehicles because of strong winds. Cars and vans are unaffected.

transcript.speaker: Presenter
transcript.text: And a reminder that the Fairport park-and-ride is running a reduced timetable this week while the car park is resurfaced — buses every twenty minutes rather than every ten.

questions.prompt: 77. Which route is most at risk of flooding?

options.text: The coastal route between Fairport and Kirby

questions.explanationVi: 'Localised flooding is likely on low-lying roads, particularly the coastal route between Fairport and Kirby'.

questions.prompt: 78. Who is affected by the bridge closure?
questions.explanationVi: 'closed to high-sided vehicles because of strong winds. Cars and vans are unaffected'.

questions.prompt: 79. How often are park-and-ride buses running this week?
questions.explanationVi: 'every twenty minutes rather than every ten'. Mười phút là tần suất bình thường.

title: Part 4 — Talk 4: introducing a new product
instructionsVi: Bài giới thiệu sản phẩm. Câu hỏi hay hỏi điểm khác biệt so với bản cũ và điều kiện ưu đãi.
promptEn: Listen to the presentation and answer questions 80 through 82.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Thanks for coming. I want to show you the CX-50, which replaces the CX-40 from October.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: The headline change isn't the motor — that's unchanged. It's the control board, which now logs temperature every thirty seconds and stores ninety days of history on the unit itself.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Why that matters: when a unit fails, the commonest question is what the conditions were beforehand, and until now the honest answer was that nobody knew.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Pricing is within two per cent of the CX-40, and existing service plans transfer across without change.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Customers who order before the end of August get the extended warranty at no cost. After that it's an option at the usual rate.

questions.prompt: 80. What is the main difference from the previous model?

options.text: A control board that logs and stores data

questions.explanationVi: 'The headline change isn't the motor — that's unchanged. It's the control board'. Câu phủ định loại thẳng (A).

questions.prompt: 81. Why does the speaker say this matters?

options.text: It makes the unit easier to install.
It answers what conditions preceded a failure.

questions.explanationVi: 'the commonest question is what the conditions were beforehand, and until now the honest answer was that nobody knew'.

questions.prompt: 82. What do customers ordering before the end of August receive?
questions.explanationVi: 'order before the end of August get the extended warranty at no cost'. Hai phần trăm là chênh lệch GIÁ, không phải giảm giá.

title: Part 4 — Talk 5: recorded information line
instructionsVi: Tổng đài tự động. Nhiều lựa chọn bấm phím nối nhau; câu hỏi hỏi phải làm gì trong một tình huống cụ thể.
promptEn: Listen to the recorded message and answer questions 83 through 85.

transcript.speaker: Recording
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Fairport City Library. Our opening hours have changed, so please listen carefully.

transcript.speaker: Recording
transcript.text: The central library is open Monday to Saturday from nine until seven, and on Sundays from eleven until four.

transcript.speaker: Recording
transcript.text: To renew a loan, press one. To reserve an item, press two. To report a lost card, press three.

transcript.speaker: Recording
transcript.text: Please note that items already overdue cannot be renewed by phone — you will need to bring them to a branch.

transcript.speaker: Recording
transcript.text: Branch libraries have separate hours, which are listed on our website. All branches are closed on Mondays.

questions.prompt: 83. What should a caller with an overdue item do?

options.text: Take the item to a branch

questions.explanationVi: 'items already overdue cannot be renewed by phone — you will need to bring them to a branch'.

questions.prompt: 84. When does the central library close on Sundays?
questions.explanationVi: 'on Sundays from eleven until four'. Bảy giờ là giờ đóng cửa các ngày trong tuần.

questions.prompt: 85. What is said about branch libraries?

options.text: They keep the same hours as the central library.
They are all closed on Mondays.
